description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different configurations in detecting misinformation, with the x-axis representing various configurations and the y-axis showing accuracy percentages. The chart is divided into two main sections, PHEME and PolitiFact, each with six bars representing different configurations: 'Ours', 'w/o comments', 'w/o text', 'w/o select', 'w/o emotion', and 'w/o cognition'. The accuracy percentages range from approximately 80.1% to 90.57%. The 'Ours' configuration consistently shows the highest accuracy across both datasets, with the highest accuracy being 90.57% in the PolitiFact dataset. The 'w/o text' configuration generally shows the lowest accuracy, with the lowest being 80.1% in the PHEME dataset. The bars are color-coded, with 'Ours' in dark blue, 'w/o comments' in light blue, 'w/o text' in yellow, 'w/o select' in light green, 'w/o emotion' in dark green, and 'w/o cognition' in orange. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
